notes: Year 0 AM by definition, not by calculation. The epoch has to be fixed somewhere and this chronology fixes it here.
Genesis 7:6 states Noah's age when the flood came, so the year follows from Noah's birth year.

Scripture states no age or interval for Babel. Genesis 10:25 says the earth was divided in Peleg's days, but that is a statement about an era, not a date, and reading it as one would be an inference the text does not make. The year stays UNKNOWN.

Genesis 12:4 states Abraham's age at the departure. Acts 7:4 places it after Terah's death, which is the figure Abraham's own birth year is derived from, so this event and his birth are two ends of the same derivation.
Genesis 47:9 has Jacob give his own age to Pharaoh on arrival.
